title: Uncertainty calibration in Bayesian M/EEG source imaging
abstract: arXiv:2611.06979v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: M/EEG source imaging requires accurate localization and reliable uncertainty estimates, yet posterior credible regions are rarely assessed for empirical calibration. We present a simulation-based framework for uncertainty quantification and calibration of empirical Bayesian inverse methods with closed-form conditional Gaussian posterior summaries. We compare Bayesian minimum norm (BMN) with sLORETA depth weighting and sparse Bayesian learning (SBL) with sparse basis field expansions (S-FLEX). S-FLEX allows retained coefficients to contribute nonzero marginal posterior variance at locations where voxel-wise SBL yields degenerate variances. For BMN, we derive joint source- and noise-variance updates through evidence maximization. We test whether adaptive noise learning yields near-calibrated uncertainties. Both methods retain residual miscalibration, motivating post-hoc isotonic recalibration of credible-region levels using empirical cover

translated_title: 贝叶斯 M/EEG 源成像中的不确定性校准
translated_abstract: M/EEG（脑磁图/脑电图）源成像需要精确的定位和可靠的不确定性估计，然而后验可信区域却很少被评估其经验校准程度。我们提出了一个基于仿真的框架，用于对具有闭式条件高斯后验摘要的经验贝叶斯逆方法进行不确定性量化与校准。我们比较了带 sLORETA 深度加权的贝叶斯最小范数（BMN）方法与带稀疏基场展开（S-FLEX）的稀疏贝叶斯学习（SBL）方法。S-FLEX 允许保留的系数在体素级 SBL 产生退化方差的位置贡献非零的边际后验方差。对于 BMN，我们通过证据最大化推导了源方差与噪声方差的联合更新。我们检验了自适应噪声学习能否产生接近校准的不确定性。两种方法均保留了残余的误校准，这促使我们利用经验覆盖率对可信区域水平进行事后等渗重校准。
tldr: 该论文提出了一个基于仿真的贝叶斯M/EEG源成像不确定性量化与校准框架，系统比较了BMN与SBL/S-FLEX两种方法，发现二者均存在残余误校准，并据此提出利用经验覆盖率对可信区域进行事后等渗重校准的方法。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a simulation-based framework for uncertainty quantification and calibration in Bayesian M/EEG source imaging, comparing BMN with SBL/S-FLEX methods, finding both retain residual miscalibration and motivating post-hoc isotonic recalibration of credible-region levels using empirical coverage.
